question: Does planner-aware listwise teacher distillation repair candidate ranking without changing the action-prefix inference interface?

arms.rankdistill: the same dense native-latent MSE plus planner-score listwise KL

design.pairing: same initial weights, anchor, action prefixes, frozen-teacher targets and step schedule
design.blocks: official anchor x fresh heldout action seed
design.update_order: alternate arm order by training step

training.anchor_schedule: alternate pusht_obs_00 and pusht_obs_01 by step

rank_loss.type: KL between teacher and student candidate-score distributions
rank_loss.score_standardization: within-anchor batch z-score with std floor 1e-6
rank_loss.logits: negative standardized official terminal objective divided by temperature

timing.boundary: cached native observation latent and normalized actions through frozen teacher rollout or one student forward

gates.no_go: any gate fails; do not enter CEM integration or change thresholds after results
